title: Supporting a Friend Through Divorce
paragraphs: When her closest friend went through an unexpected and painful divorce, Zubaida struggled to determine the appropriate balance between offering support and respecting her friend's need for space during an emotionally overwhelming period.

Rather than assuming she knew exactly what her friend needed, Zubaida asked directly, learning that consistent, low-pressure availability mattered more than frequent advice or attempts to solve the underlying situation.

Some weeks her friend wanted company and distraction, while other weeks she preferred solitude, and Zubaida gradually learned to follow her friend's lead rather than imposing her own assumptions about proper support.
A year later, her friend specifically credited Zubaida's patient, adaptable presence, rather than any particular advice given, as what helped her navigate the most difficult period of her life.
